target: NIST P-521 scalar group order n minus 2, not field p minus 2

region.forbidden_odd_helpers: all subsets of size 0 through 3 from 3,5,...,31
region.suffix_parser: same exact width-5 dynamic program and +2/+4 helper grammar as generator source
region.disjointness: prior bounded helper region used prefixes 256 through 262

arms.memory_guided: sort by 256-prefix ascending, contains helper 11 descending, then skip-set size ascending, then lexical skip tuple
arms.memory_ablated_control: sort by SHA-256 of UTF-8 seed:prefix:comma-separated-skips

primary_endpoint: lowest 0.8*squarings + multiplications among valid exact DAGs in each 1024-attempt arm; incumbent comparison separate
secondary_endpoint: lowest total operations; valid DAGs, invalid grammar cases, best-finding ordinal, process CPU ns and wall ns per arm
interpretation_limit: One case-ordering assay, with historical P-521 result informing memory arm. Not autonomous learning, native speed, published best, constant-time behavior, or global optimality.
